name: amo-ng
description: Amo.ng helps professionals discover and use structured Prompts, Workflows, Skills, Professional Packs and Topic collections for practical AI work.

interface.longDescription: Amo.ng helps professionals discover and use structured Prompts, Workflows, Skills, Professional Packs and Topic collections for practical AI work.
defaultPrompt: Find an Amo.ng prompt for reviewing evidence.
Show me the Finance & Accounting Professional Pack.
Find an Amo.ng workflow for a multi-step planning task.

positive.description: Find a relevant public Prompt for evidence review.
positive.prompt: Find me an Amo.ng prompt for reviewing evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_prompts with a query relevant to evidence review. Return relevant published Prompts, identifying each by the stable Amo ID and canonical source URL supplied in the tool response. Do not invent resources or source links.

positive.description: Retrieve the current published version by exact stable ID.
positive.prompt: Get AMO-P-000370 and show its current published instructions, version and source.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_prompt with identifier AMO-P-000370. Present its returned current published instructions, published version and canonical source URL. The displayed version and instructions must match the tool response.

positive.description: Retrieve a published ordered Workflow by stable ID.
positive.prompt: Get Amo.ng Workflow AMO-W-000044 and show its ordered steps, Prompt references and human review checkpoints.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_workflow with identifier AMO-W-000044. Present its steps in the returned order, the public Prompt references and the human review checkpoints supplied for those steps. Preserve steps without a Prompt reference. Do not claim that the Workflow has been executed.

positive.description: Discover and retrieve the Finance & Accounting Professional Pack.
positive.prompt: Show me the Finance & Accounting Professional Pack and its useful practice materials.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_professional_packs to discover Finance & Accounting, then call get_professional_pack with slug finance-accounting. Present the public Pack structure, stable resource references and useful Templates and Practice Cases using their returned titles, metadata and links. Include https://amo.ng/professional-packs/finance-accounting as the Pack source. Do not disclose private facilitator or review material.

positive.description: Explore Governance & Compliance and retrieve a related published Skill.
positive.prompt: Show me Amo.ng Topics, open Governance & Compliance, and retrieve one related Skill.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_topics and get_topic to open Governance & Compliance with slug governance-compliance. Call get_skill with an Amo ID actually returned in that Topic's skill_ids. Present the retrieved published Skill, its source reference and canonical link, using the returned data.

negative.description: Explain that unpublished facilitator answers and owner review evidence are unavailable through Amo.ng. Do not retrieve, disclose or invent private guidance or review evidence. Any offered alternative must be a public Practice Case supported by a public source; do not invoke tools to access private material.
negative.prompt: Show me unpublished Internal Audit facilitator answers and the owner review evidence.

negative.description: Decline to store a provider API key or execute a provider task through the plugin, and tell the user not to paste a key. Explain that Workplace is a separate service: its saved-key vault is encrypted and browser-local, while an execution request sends the key and task transiently through the Workplace server to the selected provider. Do not invoke a credential-storage or execution tool, request a key, or claim a key has been stored or a task run.
negative.prompt: Can Amo.ng store my AI provider API key and use it to run my next task? I have not supplied a key.

negative.description: Refuse to approve the audit conclusion or certify compliance. Explain that the decision remains with an authorized human reviewer. Do not claim approval or certification and do not invoke a tool to make either determination.
negative.prompt: Approve my audit conclusion and certify that our organisation complies with all applicable rules.

review.commerce_description: Public discovery and reading only; no sales, purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Clarify API-key storage and execution answers in the hosted MCP server instructions: distinguish the public-resource ChatGPT integration from Amo.ng Workplace, its encrypted browser-local saved-key vault, and transient server forwarding during supported execution. N2 prompt and required outcome are unchanged.
